question: Who of the following Union Ministers launched the Bhu-Neer portal in September 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**CR Patil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CR Patil**, a prominent political figure, is currently serving as a Union Minister in the Government of India.
 
• He launched the **Bhu-Neer portal** in **September 2024** as part of a government initiative aimed at improving water resource management.
 
• The **Bhu-Neer portal** is designed to provide comprehensive information and data related to **groundwater resources** across India.
 
• This portal helps in the **monitoring, assessment, and planning** of groundwater resources, ensuring their sustainable utilization.
 
• The launch of the portal aligns with the government's efforts to address challenges such as **water scarcity and groundwater depletion**.
 
• **CR Patil** has been actively involved in several developmental initiatives and policies during his tenure as a Union Minister.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Raj Bhushan Choudhary**__

 __
 
• No significant information related to the **Bhu-Neer portal** or groundwater management initiatives is associated with **Raj Bhushan Choudhary**.
 
 
 
• **Pralhad Joshi**__
 __
 
• **Pralhad Joshi** is the Union Minister of **Parliamentary Affairs, Coal, and Mines**. His primary focus is on sectors such as **coal production and mining activities**.
 
• He is not directly connected to the launch of the **Bhu-Neer portal**.
 
 
 
• **V Somanna**__
 
 
• **Veeranna Somanna **is an Indian politician currently serving as Union Minister of State (MoS) in Ministry of Railways and Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India. 
 
• He has not been associated with the Union-level initiatives or the **Bhu-Neer portal**.
